items: Player telemetry rich but decision loops slow; content bets anecdotal.
Launch/patch peaks crashed cost and reliability models.

blocks.x: The player-intelligence platform unified telemetry with decision lineage feeding content and economy teams; live-ops orchestration automated events and balancing with human signoff; peak engineering (load/chaos) stabilized launches; and integrity detection scaled against cheating economies.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.
